description: Scenario chat page (pages/1_Scenarios.py) and Mistake Deck page (pages/2_Mistake_Deck.py). Both depend on FEAT-001 (core layer) and FEAT-002 (app.py entry point and DB initialisation). These two pages are grouped because the Mistake Deck is only meaningful once the chat page can produce corrections to review.
steps: Create /Users/family/Documents/Deushchat/pages/1_Scenarios.py. Imports: streamlit as st, uuid, json, from core import db, llm, from data.scenarios import SCENARIOS, from core.db import get_or_create_db. Call get_or_create_db() at top. Load profile via db.get_profile(); if None redirect to app.py with st.switch_page('app.py').

Scenario grid view: when st.session_state.get('active_scenario') is None, render 4-column grid with st.columns(4). For each scenario in SCENARIOS render a button labelled with emoji + name + difficulty badge. On click: set st.session_state keys active_scenario, chat_history=[], completed_goals=[], session_id=str(uuid.uuid4()), show_hint=False. Call st.rerun().

Chat view (active_scenario is set): Show header with scenario name and difficulty. Show st.info() with setup_en text. Show goals list — for each goal show '✅' if index in completed_goals else '⬜', then the goal text. Add a 'Back to scenarios' button that clears active_scenario and reruns.

Render chat history: iterate st.session_state.chat_history. For user messages use st.chat_message('user'); for assistant use st.chat_message('assistant'). Under each user message, if the message dict has a 'correction' key and correction['error_type'] != 'none': render st.expander('📝 Correction', expanded=True) showing original→corrected sentence, reason text, and an error_type badge using st.badge or colored st.markdown.

Hint button: st.button('💡 Show Hint'). On click set st.session_state.show_hint = True and st.rerun(). If show_hint is True: show st.info with hint text and hint_translation from the last assistant turn. Add a 'Hide hint' button to reset it.

Chat input: st.chat_input('Type your German reply…'). On user submission: (a) check llm.check_ollama_running(), show st.error and st.stop() if False. (b) call llm.get_scenario_reply(profile, scenario, completed_goals, llm_history, user_input) where llm_history is chat_history filtered to {role,content} only. (c) Append user message to chat_history as {role:'user', content:user_input, correction:result['correction']}. (d) Append assistant message as {role:'assistant', content:result['reply'], hint:result['hint'], hint_translation:result['hint_translation']}. (e) Merge result['goals_completed'] into completed_goals (set union). (f) If correction.error_type != 'none': call db.save_card(original, corrected + '\n' + reason, error_type, scenario['id']). (g) Call db.save_message() for both turns. (h) st.rerun().
Create /Users/family/Documents/Deushchat/pages/2_Mistake_Deck.py. Imports: streamlit as st, from core import db, from core.db import get_or_create_db. Call get_or_create_db() at top.

Review section: on page load or when 'review_cards' not in session_state, call db.get_due_cards(), shuffle with random.shuffle(), store in st.session_state.review_cards. Set review_index=0, card_flipped=False if not present.
If no cards due: show st.success('No cards due today! Come back tomorrow. 🎉') and skip to dashboard.

Show st.progress(review_index / len(review_cards)). Show current card front: st.markdown(f'**{card["front"]}**'). If not flipped: st.button('Reveal answer') → set card_flipped=True, st.rerun(). If flipped: show card back text, then two columns with st.button('✅ Got it') and st.button('❌ Try again'). Each button calls db.update_card_review(card_id, got_it), increments review_index, resets card_flipped, calls st.rerun(). When review_index >= len(review_cards): show completion message.

Dashboard section below review: st.subheader('Your error patterns'). Call db.get_error_stats() and render as st.bar_chart (convert list of dicts to pandas-compatible format) or st.dataframe if no data.
acceptance_criteria: streamlit run app.py starts, navigate to Scenarios page — 8 scenario cards render in grid without errors
Clicking a scenario card opens the chat view with setup card and goals list
Typing a message in the chat input and pressing Enter calls the LLM (or shows Ollama error) without crashing
After a successful LLM response, the correction panel appears under the user message when error_type != 'none'
Goals tick from ⬜ to ✅ when the model returns them in goals_completed
Hint button is hidden by default; clicking it reveals hint text
Navigate to Mistake Deck — if cards exist, flashcard front shows; Reveal Answer shows back; Got it / Try again buttons update the card and advance to next
Error dashboard renders without crashing even when cards table is empty
